input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-fee or early-termination charge payable by Sparkling. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty" and late-payment interest return nothing relevant; Section 11 (p0084) simply requires payment of Fee Schedule fees, and Section 17(b) (p0118) permits Sparkling to terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice with no termination fee or minimum-commitment payment. The only money flowing on default runs in our favour (p0128: converted perpetual licence plus refund of fees for services not rendered), and the single reference to "penalties" (p0090) is within Garman's IP indemnity of Sparkling's Losses. This meets the preferred position — no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer — so no redline is proposed.
